title: UltraText Bench: A Comprehensive Bilingual Benchmark for Evaluating Visual Text Rendering in Image Generation
title_zh: Dense visual text benchmark: UltraText Bench 用于评估图像生成中的密集视觉文本渲染效果

paragraphs.en: Dense visual text requires image generators to reproduce long strings across multiple regions with correct placement and legibility. As short-string rendering improves, evaluation must test sustained performance across more demanding scenes. We introduce UltraText Bench , a bilingual benchmark for prompt-only generation of dense visual text. It contains 432 prompts spanning 24 real-world scene categories and three difficulty levels, split equally between English and Chinese. Each human-reviewed prompt supplies exact strings for four to twelve text regions, paired with structured references for their content, placement, and visual attributes. We use the Q-Judger vision-language model to assess each image against the complete reference, reporting text fidelity, text clarity, spatial quality, and scene quality. Across 24 model configurations, these dimensions reveal different strengths: Z-Image-Turbo gains 3.81 clarity points over Z-Image-Base while losing 14.76 fidelity points under the reported settings. Performance also varies with workload; Qwen-Image-2512’s English composite falls from 86.50 at L1 to 42.86 at L3. Ten participants took part in human evaluation of the automatic scores. Repository: https://github.com/LINs-lab/UltraText_Bench .
paragraphs.zh: 密集视觉文本需要图像生成器在多个区域中正确放置并清晰呈现长字符串。 随着短字符串渲染技术的进步，评估必须测试模型在更具挑战性的场景中的持续表现。 我们提出了 UltraText Bench，一个用于仅通过提示生成密集视觉文本的双语基准测试。 该基准包含 432 个提示，涵盖 24 种真实世界场景类别和三个难度等级，中英文各占一半。 每个经过人工审核的提示都提供了四到十二个文本区域的精确字符串，并附带其内容、位置和视觉属性的结构化参考信息。 我们使用 Q-Judger 视觉语言模型对每幅图像与完整参考进行对比评估，报告文本保真度、文本清晰度、空间质量和场景质量。 在 24 种模型配置中，这些维度揭示了不同的优势：在报告的设置下，Z-Image-Turbo 的清晰度比 Z-Image-Base 高出 3.81 分，但保真度降低了 14.76 分。 性能也随工作负载变化；Qwen-Image-2512 的英文综合得分从 L1 的 86.50 降至 L3 的 42.86。 共有十名参与者参与了自动评分的人工评估。 代码库：https://github.com/LINs-lab/UltraText_Bench .

paragraphs.en: Text-to-image (T2I) models now produce images of high visual quality across diverse prompts ( Rombach et al., 2022 ; Saharia et al., 2022 ) . Visual text rendering requires legible, correctly spelled characters at their intended positions. Recent models have improved short-string rendering ( Wu et al., 2025a ; Labs, 2025 ; OpenAI, 2025 ; OpenAI, 2023 ; Esser et al., 2024 ) . Evaluation must now examine whether this ability extends to hundreds or thousands of characters across multiple regions ( Du et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025a ) . Posters, product packaging, documents, receipts, forms, and interfaces require this sustained performance ( Peng et al., 2025 ) : titles, body text, and small supporting regions must all remain correct and legible. A missing price or an incorrect opening time can change the information conveyed even when the overall composition and lettering look convincing.
paragraphs.zh: 文本到图像（T2I）模型如今能够根据各种提示生成高质量的图像（Rombach 等人，2022；Saharia 等人，2022）。 视觉文本渲染需要字符清晰可辨、拼写正确，并位于预期的位置。 近期的模型已改进了短字符串的渲染效果（Wu 等人，2025a；Labs，2025；OpenAI，2025；OpenAI，2023；Esser 等人，2024）。 如今，评估必须检验这种能力是否可扩展至跨越多个区域的数百或数千个字符（Du 等人，2025；Zhang 等人，2025a）。 海报、产品包装、文档、收据、表格和界面都需要这种持续稳定的表现（Peng 等人，2025）：标题、正文以及小型辅助区域都必须保持正确且清晰可辨。 即使整体构图和字体看起来令人信服，缺失的价格或错误的开放时间也可能改变所传达的信息。

paragraphs.en: To evaluate these applications, we treat visual text generation as a text reproduction task: all target strings are supplied in the prompt, and the model must render them in the specified regions. Evaluation requires a dense text load : prompts that request many regions carrying hundreds to thousands of target characters. A long passage tests sustained rendering within one block; distributed regions also test whether all requested text remains correctly placed. Whole-scene evaluation requires considering every requested region against a structured reference of its text, placement, and carrier, the physical surface or digital element bearing it. A correct title can coexist with missing, incorrect, or unreadable text elsewhere in the image. illustrates these errors alongside failures of placement and integration with the text carrier.
paragraphs.zh: 为了评估这些应用，我们将视觉文本生成视为一种文本再现任务：所有目标字符串都在提示词中提供，模型必须将其渲染到指定的区域。 评估需要密集的文本负载：提示词要求多个区域承载数百到数千个目标字符。 一段长文本会测试在单个区块内的持续渲染能力；分布式的区域还会检验所有要求的文本是否都保持正确的位置。 全场景评估需要考虑每个要求的区域，并将其与一个结构化的参考进行比对，该参考包含其文本、位置以及承载它的物理表面或数字元素。 一个正确的标题可以与图像中其他位置缺失、错误或不清晰的文本共存。该图展示了这些错误，以及位置错误和与文本载体整合失败的情况。

paragraphs.en: Existing benchmarks address several parts of this task. CVTG-2K evaluates multiple text instances with position and attribute descriptions ( Du et al., 2025 ) , and LongText-Bench targets longer English and Chinese text ( Geng et al., 2025 ) . STRICT reaches thousand-character sequences ( Zhang et al., 2025b ) , while OCRGenBench includes dense page-level tasks ( Zhang et al., 2025a ) . InfoTextBench is the closest comparison for dense bilingual text, with target-string lists and OCR- and VLM-based evaluation ( Xiang et al., 2026 ) . UltraText Bench combines 24 scene categories with a uniform per-region reference and a shared rubric for text, layout, and scene integration. It keeps target strings linked to their intended visual roles across documents, physical signs, and digital interfaces. compares these benchmarks and their evaluation protocols.
paragraphs.zh: 现有的基准测试涵盖了该任务中的几个部分。 CVTG-2K 评估了多个带有位置和属性描述的文本实例（Du et al., 2025），而 LongText-Bench 则针对更长的英文和中文文本（Geng et al., 2025）。 STRICT 可处理千字符序列（Zhang et al., 2025b），而 OCRGenBench 则包含了密集的页面级任务（Zhang et al., 2025a）。 InfoTextBench 是用于密集双语文本的最接近的对比基准，它包含目标字符串列表以及基于 OCR 和 VLM 的评估方法（Xiang et al., 2026）。 UltraText Bench 将 24 个场景类别与统一的区域参考以及适用于文本、布局和场景整合的共享评分标准相结合。 它在不同文档、实体标识牌和数字界面中保持目标字符串与其预期视觉角色之间的关联，并对这些基准测试及其评估协议进行比较。

paragraphs.en: We introduce UltraText Bench , a bilingual benchmark built on the two requirements above. It contains 432 prompts spanning 24 real-world scene categories in six domains, at three difficulty levels and split equally between English and Chinese. Each prompt requests four to twelve text regions : individually annotated target-text components, such as a shop name or a multi-line menu. Each record pairs a generation prompt containing every target string with structured per-region ground truth (GT), used only for evaluation. paragraphs.en: Visual text generation methods differ in how they encode exact character sequences, how they obtain a layout, and how well text survives being encoded and decoded by the image model.
paragraphs.zh: 视觉文本生成方法在精确字符序列的编码方式、布局的获取方式，以及文本经过图像模型编码和解码后的保留效果方面存在差异。

paragraphs.en: GlyphControl ( Yang et al., 2023 ) adds a ControlNet branch conditioned on a rendered glyph map, while GlyphDraw ( Ma et al., 2023 ) combines glyph information with spatial control for Chinese and English text. TextDiffuser ( Chen et al., 2023 ) instead predicts character-level layout masks before image synthesis, and TextDiffuser-2 ( Chen et al., 2024 ) uses a language model to plan keywords and bounding boxes from open-ended prompts. These approaches tie a string more firmly to a place in the image, but they do not assume the same input: glyph-conditioned systems receive an explicit visual control, whereas layout-first systems must predict a layout whose errors can propagate to image generation.
paragraphs.zh: GlyphControl（Yang 等人，2023）增加了一个基于渲染出的字形图的 ControlNet 分支，而 GlyphDraw（Ma 等人，2023）则将字形信息与空间控制相结合，用于中文和英文文本。 TextDiffuser（Chen 等人，2023）则是在图像合成之前预测字符级别的布局掩码，而 TextDiffuser-2（Chen 等人，2024）则使用语言模型从开放式提示中规划关键词和边界框。 这些方法将字符串更紧密地绑定到图像中的特定位置，但它们并不假设相同的输入：基于字形条件的系统接收明确的视觉控制，而优先布局的系统则需要预测一个布局，其错误可能会传播到图像生成过程中。

paragraphs.en: MARIO-Eval ( Chen et al., 2023 ) established a large short-keyword test set. AnyText-Bench ( Tuo et al., 2024 ) added English and Chinese generation tests whose OCR scores are computed on text lines cropped at the specified positions; the AnyText model also edits text, but the benchmark’s quantitative protocol is generation-oriented. TypeScore ( Sampaio et al., 2024 ) moved past a single OCR accuracy value: it extracts the rendered text and combines several string-comparison measures into one fidelity score. That score tells spelling errors, missing text, and extra text apart, and it is validated against human judgments. LeX-Bench ( Zhao et al., 2025 ) adds prompts that also constrain color, font, and position, and scores them with PNED, which matches requested against recognized words and penalizes the ones left over. Because PNED treats words as an unordered set, it says nothing about reading order or about which surface a string ended up on. These resources primarily measure short-string accuracy and text attributes.

LongText-Bench, introduced with X-Omni, covers longer English and Chinese text across eight scenarios ( Geng et al., 2025 ) , and document-level rendering of a single long sequence has been examined separately ( Zhang et al., 2025b ) . The closest neighbor is InfoTextBench, released with GlyphAnchor ( Xiang et al., 2026 ) , which pairs English and Chinese prompts over text-rich reference images, gives each one an explicit list of target strings, and scores word-level precision, recall, and phrase hits. Long targets, images holding many separate pieces of text, and bilingual coverage have therefore all been studied before. These resources differ in how target strings, attributes, positions, and scene context are represented and evaluated.

paragraphs.en: VTR-Bench ( Huang et al., 2026 ) evaluates visual text rendering in video generation. It assesses text fidelity through carrier-specific transcription and scene and motion requirements through prompt-specific queries. This temporal setting complements our evaluation of dense text and region placement within individual images.

paragraphs.en: TextAtlas5M ( Wang et al., 2025a ) contributes large-scale training data for long and structured text, together with TextAtlasEval, an evaluation set spanning four design domains in which one subset varies text length under otherwise fixed conditions. OCRGenBench ( Zhang et al., 2025a ) broadens evaluation to generation, editing, and OCR-oriented transformation tasks in English and Chinese, and explicitly includes high text density, page-level generation, and dense-document editing. VTPBench ( Shu et al., 2025 ) unifies six visual text processing tasks under task-specific metrics and VTPScore, and OneIG-Bench ( Chang et al., 2026 ) contributes a bilingual text-rendering split inside a broader image-generation suite. Task-family aggregates summarize broad performance, while trends with text load and region count require separate breakdowns. A separate line of benchmarks targets text-centric editing , which requires modifying the target text while preserving other text and the background. TextEditBench ( Gui et al., 2025 ) covers everyday document and signage scenes and adds a dimension for edits that depend on reasoning. WeEdit ( Zhang et al., 2026a ) extends editing to many languages and scores instruction adherence, text clarity, and background preservation. TextSculpt-Bench ( Lin et al., 2026 ) compares the text that should appear in the whole image against the text that actually does, and checks the background outside the edited area. TextWand-Bench ( Wang et al., 2026a ) evaluates removal, generation, and replacement under explicit layout and style control. None of these is directly comparable to prompt-only generation, because the model is handed a source image and part of the reference is the input itself. They are still instructive here: TextSculpt-Bench in particular shows that checking all the text has to leave behind evidence that can be inspected, since handing an evaluator a complete reference does not prove that it looked at every region.

paragraphs.en: General text-to-image benchmarks such as TIFA ( Hu et al., 2023 ) , T2I-CompBench ( Huang et al., 2023 ) , and HRS-Bench ( Bakr et al., 2023 ) measure semantic faithfulness and composition over broader prompt families. The generator receives all target strings in natural language; the six-field annotation is reserved for evaluation and stays consistent across scenes, languages, and levels. This design tests whether text rendering transfers across carriers and layouts under increasing text load. The reference specifies coarse spatial metadata, and the protocol returns image-level scores; region-level attribution remains a future direction.

paragraphs.en: Automatic generation evaluation spans global alignment and preference metrics, fidelity measures from OCR output, and VLM judges that follow a written rubric. CLIPScore ( Hessel et al., 2021 ) measures global image-text similarity, while ImageReward ( Xu et al., 2023 ) , HPSv2 ( Wu et al., 2023 ) , and PickScore ( Kirstain et al., 2023 ) learn scalar preferences from human comparisons. These scores are useful for semantic alignment or overall preference, but their training objectives do not require transcribing every requested character and can favor an attractive image whose text is incorrect. Text-specific metrics provide a closer signal. TypeScore ( Sampaio et al., 2024 ) , described above, also reports a failure mode on the evaluator’s side: OCR can introduce recognition errors, while a VLM reader can silently correct characters that the image actually renders wrongly. OCRGenScore ( Zhang et al., 2025a ) combines metrics across OCR-generative tasks, and VTPScore ( Shu et al., 2025 ) uses a multimodal model to rate visual quality and text readability across visual text processing tasks. OCR-based scores depend on the detector, recognizer, language settings, font, scale, and image domain ( Baek et al., 2019 ; Cui et al., 2025 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 自动生成的评估涵盖全局对齐和偏好指标、来自 OCR 输出的保真度度量，以及遵循书面评分标准的 VLM 评判者。 CLIPScore（Hessel 等，2021）衡量图像与文本的全局相似性，而 ImageReward（Xu 等，2023）、HPSv2（Wu 等，2023）和 PickScore（Kirstain 等，2023）则通过人类比较学习标量偏好。 这些分数对语义对齐或整体偏好很有用，但它们的训练目标并不要求转录所有请求的字符，并且可能倾向于选择图像美观但文本错误的情况。 针对文本的特定指标能够提供更贴近实际表现的信号。 上文提到的 TypeScore（Sampaio 等，2024）还报告了评估器端的一种失效模式：OCR 可能会引入识别错误，而 VLM 阅读器则可能悄无声息地修正图像中实际渲染错误的字符。 OCRGenScore（Zhang 等，2025a）整合了 OCR-生成任务中的多种指标，而 VTPScore（Shu 等，2025）则使用多模态模型对视觉文本处理任务中的视觉质量和文本可读性进行评分。 基于 OCR 的分数取决于检测器、识别器、语言设置、字体、缩放比例和图像领域（Baek 等，2019；Cui 等，2025）。

paragraphs.en: A complementary line evaluates the visual quality of rendered text separately from its correctness. TIQA ( Koltsov et al., 2026 ) collects human quality ratings for rendered text, on crops and on text-heavy images, and trains a model to predict them; this is what our clarity dimension tries to capture. Because it rates regions that were detected, it cannot by itself report a region that was requested and never rendered. Recognized strings alone also do not establish whether text occupies the requested region or integrates naturally with its carrier.
paragraphs.zh: 一条补充性评估线则独立于文本正确性，专门评估渲染文本的视觉质量。 TIQA（Koltsov 等人，2026）收集了人类对渲染文本的质量评分，涵盖裁剪区域和文本密集型图像，并训练模型进行预测；这正是我们的清晰度维度试图捕捉的内容。 由于它仅对已检测到的区域进行评分，因此无法单独报告一个被请求但从未被渲染的区域。 仅凭识别出的字符串本身，也无法确定文本是否占据了所请求的区域，或是否与承载其自然融合。

paragraphs.en: Prompted VLM evaluators can apply task-specific rubrics without training a separate metric for every dimension. VIEScore ( Ku et al., 2024 ) scores semantic consistency and perceptual quality with explanations, and UniGenBench++ ( Wang et al., 2025b ) uses structured semantic units for multidimensional T2I evaluation. Qwen-Image-Bench (QIB) ( Li et al., 2026a ) develops fine-grained creation rubrics and a dedicated Q-Judger using professional human ratings. RichHF ( Liang et al., 2024 ) likewise demonstrates the value of fine-grained human feedback tied to words and image regions. T2LSC-Bench ( Wang et al., 2026b ) pairs OCR verification with a structured VLM judgement, separating whether the text landed on its intended anchor from whether its meaning leaked into the surrounding subject and scene, and it checks the automatic labels against a human-annotated subset. Evaluator version, prompting, text-reading ability, and visual-quality bias can affect VLM scores. Prior studies examine agreement with independent human ratings ( Zheng et al., 2023 ) , controlled annotation protocols for T2I evaluation ( Otani et al., 2023 ) , and variation in text-reading ability across multimodal models ( Liu et al., 2023 ; Fu et al., 2026 ) . These limitations motivate joint assessment of text, placement, and scene integration, while keeping response-format validity distinct from the reliability of a judge’s assessment.

sents.zh: 评估者版本、提示方式、文本阅读能力以及视觉质量偏见都可能影响 VLM 的评分结果。

sents.en: Prior studies examine agreement with independent human ratings ( Zheng et al., 2023 ) , controlled annotation protocols for T2I evaluation ( Otani et al., 2023 ) , and variation in text-reading ability across multimodal models ( Liu et al., 2023 ; Fu et al., 2026 ) .
sents.zh: 以往的研究探讨了与独立人类评分的一致性（Zheng 等人，2023）、T2I 评估中受控的标注协议（Otani 等人，2023），以及多模态模型之间文本阅读能力的差异（Liu 等人，2023；Fu 等人，2026）。

sents.en: These limitations motivate joint assessment of text, placement, and scene integration, while keeping response-format validity distinct from the reliability of a judge’s assessment.
sents.zh: 这些局限性促使我们联合评估文本、位置与场景的整合情况，同时需将响应格式的有效性与其判断结果的可靠性区分开来。

paragraphs.en: The 24 categories cover different carriers and layouts, from signs to invoices and code. Three difficulty levels increase text load and region count, while the English and Chinese splits cover different glyph inventories and writing conventions ( Ma et al., 2023 ; Tuo et al., 2024 ) . These choices support comparisons across scene, workload, and language. Because text load and region count change together, the levels do not isolate their individual effects.
paragraphs.zh: 这 24 个类别涵盖了不同的载体和布局，从标识到发票再到代码。 三种难度级别会逐步增加文本负载量和区域数量，而英语与中文的划分则覆盖了不同的字形集和书写规范（Ma et al., 2023；Tuo et al., 2024）。 这些选择支持在场景、工作负载和语言维度上进行比较。 由于文本负载量和区域数量是同步变化的，因此这些级别无法单独区分它们各自的影响。

paragraphs.en: Each category × \times level × \times language cell contains three prompts, yielding 24 × 3 × 2 × 3 = 432 24\times 3\times 2\times 3=432 prompts. Three prompts per cell preserve taxonomy coverage within the generation and inspection budget. Four samples per prompt give 12 images per cell and 288 per level and language in a complete run. This supports aggregate analysis while retaining category coverage; individual cells have limited statistical precision. The suite is a stress test rather than a frequency-weighted sample of web images. Its layouts place different demands on spatial organization: receipts align items with prices, newspapers separate columns and headlines, and signs follow the perspective of their carriers.
paragraphs.zh: 每个类别 × 层级 × 语言单元格都包含三个提示，由此产生 24 × 3 × 2 × 3 = 432 个提示。 每个单元格包含三个提示，可在生成与检查预算范围内保持分类覆盖性。 每个提示包含四个样本，因此每次完整运行中，每个单元格可生成 12 张图像，每个层级和语言组合共生成 288 张图像。 这种方式支持汇总分析，同时保留类别覆盖性；但单个单元格的统计精度有限。 该套件是一项压力测试，而非对网络图像按频率加权的抽样。 其布局对空间组织提出了不同要求：收据将商品与价格对齐，报纸分隔栏目和标题，而标识则遵循其承载物的视角。

paragraphs.en: UltraText Bench uses three language-specific difficulty levels: L1 (Hard), L2 (Very Hard), and L3 (Extreme). Mean GT-character load and region count increase across these levels in both languages. A prompt’s GT-character load is ∑ i | t i | \sum_{i}|t_{i}| , the sum of Unicode characters in all region strings, including spaces and punctuation. compares the design bands with the realized workloads. All bounds are inclusive: EN bands share endpoints, ZH bands overlap, and L3 is open ended in both languages. Levels describe assigned workloads rather than disjoint character-count bins, with region count providing an additional difficulty axis.
paragraphs.zh: UltraText Bench 采用三种针对特定语言的难度等级：L1（困难）、L2（非常困难）和 L3（极端困难）。 在这两种语言中，平均 GT 字符负载和区域数量都随着这些难度等级的提升而增加。 提示的 GT 字符负载为 ∑ i | t i | \sum_{i}|t_{i}|，即所有区域字符串中 Unicode 字符（包括空格和标点符号）的总和，并与设计范围进行比较，以评估实际工作负载。 所有界限均为包含性界限：EN 范围共享端点，ZH 范围存在重叠，而 L3 在两种语言中都是开放式的。 这些等级描述的是分配的工作负载，而非互斥的字符数量区间，同时区域数量提供了另一个难度维度。

paragraphs.en: The six raw scores describe different, potentially overlapping failure modes. For concise reporting, we pair correctness with completeness and position with layout, while retaining readability as text clarity and scene integration as scene quality. Clearly drawn but misspelled text can score differently on fidelity and clarity. The raw TA and TC scores remain available to distinguish correctness from completeness. For example, the menu in receives TA=10 and TC=100, yielding Fidelity=55. Reporting only this average would conceal the large difference between the two raw ratings. paragraphs.en: Q-Judger applies the six-score rubric with the settings in . Rankings use these VLM ratings and the aggregation in . For each prompt, we average its valid image scores; prompt-macro aggregation then gives each represented prompt equal weight. The bilingual result averages the EN and ZH prompt-macro means equally. Prompts with no valid score contribute only to coverage denominators. paragraphs.en: Diffusion models ( Ho et al., 2020 ) operate in continuous visual spaces where approximate similarity is usually acceptable: small geometric or texture errors often preserve the intended object. Text is different because it is discrete and compositional; one wrong character can invalidate a word, code token, phone number, price, or form field. Self-attention in DiT ( Peebles and Xie, 2023 ) and UNet ( Rombach et al., 2022 ) architectures must split capacity between global composition and many local character patterns, and dense prompts spread this burden across multiple text regions. Text-annotated image pairs are rarer than ordinary image-caption pairs in web corpora ( OpenAI, 2023 ) , and incidental scene text is often noisy or weakly described. CLIP ( Radford et al., 2021 ) and T5 ( Raffel et al., 2020 ) use subword tokenization, while accurate text rendering requires preserving the exact character sequence. VAE latents can lose small stroke details, a limitation also emphasized by OCRGenBench ( Zhang et al., 2025a ) . Visual-tokenizer evaluations further show that standard reconstruction metrics can conceal losses in text-bearing regions ( Wu et al., 2025b ) . These mechanisms may contribute to differences between text fidelity, layout, and scene quality. Their causal effects remain untested here.
paragraphs.zh: 扩散模型（Ho 等人，2020）在连续的视觉空间中运行，其中近似的相似性通常可以接受：微小的几何或纹理错误往往不会破坏预期的物体。 文本则不同，因为它是离散的且具有组合性的；一个错误的字符就可能使单词、代码标记、电话号码、价格或表单字段失效。 DiT（Peebles 和 Xie，2023）与 UNet（Rombach 等人，2022）架构中的自注意力机制必须在全局构图与众多局部字符模式之间分配容量，而密集提示会将这一负担分散到多个文本区域。 在网页语料库中，带有文本标注的图像对比普通图像-描述对更为罕见（OpenAI，2023），且场景中的附带文本常常存在噪声或描述模糊。 CLIP（Radford 等人，2021）和 T5（Raffel 等人，2020）使用子词分词，而精确的文本渲染则需要保留确切的字符序列。 VAE 潜在变量可能会丢失细小的笔画细节，这一局限性也得到 OCRGenBench（Zhang 等人，2025a）的强调。 视觉分词器的评估进一步表明，标准的重建指标可能会掩盖包含文本区域中的损失（Wu 等人，2025b）。 这些机制可能造成了文本保真度、布局与场景质量之间的差异。 其因果关系在此尚未得到验证。

sents.en: VAE latents can lose small stroke details, a limitation also emphasized by OCRGenBench ( Zhang et al., 2025a ) .
sents.zh: VAE 潜在变量可能会丢失细小的笔画细节，这一局限性也得到 OCRGenBench（Zhang 等人，2025a）的强调。

sents.en: Visual-tokenizer evaluations further show that standard reconstruction metrics can conceal losses in text-bearing regions ( Wu et al., 2025b ) .
sents.zh: 视觉分词器的评估进一步表明，标准的重建指标可能会掩盖包含文本区域中的损失（Wu 等人，2025b）。

sents.en: These mechanisms may contribute to differences between text fidelity, layout, and scene quality.
sents.zh: 这些机制可能造成了文本保真度、布局与场景质量之间的差异。

sents.en: Their causal effects remain untested here.
sents.zh: 其因果关系在此尚未得到验证。

paragraphs.en: Potential training directions for dense text rendering include visual representation warmup, as in ERW ( Liu et al., 2025 ) , and optimization with text-specific feedback. The structured annotations can support region-level diagnosis and feedback on character errors, omissions, placement, and scene integration. Such feedback can guide reward-based optimization, including DDPO ( Black et al., 2024 ) , ReFL ( Xu et al., 2023 ) , and AlignProp ( Prabhudesai et al., 2023 ) , or the construction of preference pairs used by methods such as Diffusion-DPO ( Wallace et al., 2024 ) and FlowCPO ( Han et al., 2026 ) . Although importance does not enter our scoring formulas, future training objectives could use it to weight errors in a shop name more heavily than errors in a footnote. This direction is aligned with region-level feedback work such as RichHF-18K ( Liang et al., 2024 ) , but focuses specifically on visual text rendering.
paragraphs.zh: 密集文本渲染的潜在训练方向包括视觉表示预热（如 ERW（Liu 等人，2025））以及使用文本特定反馈进行优化。 结构化标注可以支持区域级诊断，并对字符错误、遗漏、位置及场景整合提供反馈。 此类反馈可以指导基于奖励的优化方法，包括 DDPO（Black 等人，2024）、ReFL（Xu 等人，2023）和 AlignProp（Prabhudesai 等人，2023），或用于构建偏好对，供 Diffusion-DPO（Wallace 等人，2024）和 FlowCPO（Han 等人，2026）等方法使用。 尽管重要性并未进入我们的评分公式，但未来的训练目标可以将其用于对商店名称中的错误赋予比脚注中错误更高的权重。 这一方向与 RichHF-18K（Liang 等人，2024）等区域级反馈研究一致，但专门聚焦于视觉文本渲染。

paragraphs.en: UltraText Bench combines scene coverage and per-region references. STRICT ( Zhang et al., 2025b ) also evaluates thousands of characters, but varies one sequence on a plain page; UltraText Bench distributes text over 4–12 annotated regions with carriers and positions across 24 categories. OCRGenBench ( Zhang et al., 2025a ) spans several OCR-generative tasks, including dense pages, while UltraText Bench focuses on prompt-only generation. InfoTextBench ( Xiang et al., 2026 ) is the closest comparison for dense bilingual text, but its target-text items differ from our regions, preventing direct comparison of their counts.
paragraphs.zh: UltraText Bench 结合了场景覆盖和区域级参考。 STRICT（Zhang 等人，2025b）也评估了数千个字符，但仅在一个普通页面上改变一个序列；而 UltraText Bench 则将文本分布在 4–12 个带有载体和位置标注的区域中，涵盖 24 个类别。 OCRGenBench（Zhang 等人，2025a）涵盖了多种 OCR-生成任务，包括密集页面，而 UltraText Bench 则专注于仅通过提示词进行生成。 InfoTextBench（Xiang 等人，2026）是用于密集双语文本的最接近的对比基准，但其目标文本项与我们的区域不同，因此无法直接比较它们的数量。

paragraphs.en: Results reflect each model’s standard generation settings, which can differ in resolution, aspect ratio, and API behavior. A controlled comparison of these factors remains future work. Each category × \times level × \times language cell contains 3 prompts and 12 images in a complete run. A language–level aggregate contains 72 prompts, and a language aggregate contains 216. Repeated images share a prompt, so prompt-level variation is the relevant unit for comparing aggregate scores. We report descriptive means without confidence intervals; close ranks and fine-grained cell differences require correspondingly cautious interpretation. The protocol returns image-level scores from one VLM judge. Ten participants took part in human evaluation of the automatic scores; discusses its scope and limitations. Quantitative inter-rater agreement and alignment with human ratings are not reported here. The per-region references specify the content and visual context for assessment, while the current output summarizes each image as a whole. Maximum scores are frequent in the GPT Image 2 records, and selected cases show both low-score disagreements and visible errors despite maximum ratings. The examples distinguish local character defects from an image’s overall rating; they do not quantify the judge’s error rate. A maximum rating is not a measured percentage of correct characters. Strong aggregate performance and occasional local disagreements therefore need to be interpreted at their respective scales. The language splits use independently written content and different character-load bands, and difficulty levels change text load and region count together. Their comparisons therefore do not isolate language or text length alone.
paragraphs.zh: 结果反映了每个模型的标准生成设置，这些设置在分辨率、宽高比和 API 行为方面可能存在差异。 对这些因素进行受控比较仍属于未来的工作。 每个类别 × 级别 × 语言单元格在一次完整运行中包含 3 个提示和 12 张图片。 一个语言–级别的汇总数据包含 72 个提示，而一个语言汇总数据则包含 216 个。 重复的图片共享同一个提示，因此提示级别的差异是比较汇总得分时的相关单位。 我们报告了描述性均值而未提供置信区间；相近的排名和精细单元格差异需要相应谨慎地解读。 该协议从一个 VLM 评判者处获取图片级别的得分。 十名参与者参与了自动得分的人工评估；文中讨论了其范围与局限性。 此处未报告定量的评分者间一致性以及与人工评分的吻合度。 每个区域的参考信息明确了评估所需的内容和视觉背景，而当前输出则对每张图片进行了整体总结。 GPT Image 2 的记录中频繁出现最高分，而部分案例显示，尽管获得了最高评分，仍存在低分分歧和明显的错误。 这些示例区分了局部字符缺陷与图片的整体评分；它们并未量化评判者的错误率。 最高评分并非正确字符所占比例的测量值。 因此，强劲的整体表现与偶尔的局部分歧需要在其各自的尺度上进行解读。 语言分支使用了独立编写的内容和不同的字符负载区间，且难度级别会同时改变文本负载和区域数量。 因此，它们的比较无法单独区分语言或文本长度的影响。

paragraphs.zh: UltraText Bench 对包含完整区域引用的密集双语文本，在 24 个场景类别中进行了评估。 通过对比 24 种模型配置，可以区分保真度与清晰度，并揭示不同工作负载和语言之间的差异。 该套件支持对持续文本的再现、定位以及与周围场景的整合进行评估。

paragraphs.en: Appendix guide. describes how the prompts were built, what each annotation field means, and what every category asks for. reproduces one record in full and follows a single scene family across the three levels. gives the judge prompt verbatim, the reference payload that accompanies it, and the workflow that turns an image into a scored row. sets out how the six raw scores become four reporting dimensions and one composite, worked through on one recorded response. explains how region references support the existing scores and how to interpret performance as model capabilities improve. reads seven generated images against their references and collects the per-category galleries. records which artifacts exist for this revision and what they cannot establish. describes the scope of human evaluation and the interpretation of qualitative examples.
paragraphs.zh: 附录指南。描述了提示词的构建方式、每个标注字段的含义以及各类别的具体要求。完整复现了一条记录，并贯穿三个层级对单个场景家族进行了分析。逐字提供了评审提示词、随附的参考载荷，以及将图像转化为得分行的工作流程。阐明了六个原始分数如何转化为四个报告维度和一个综合得分，并以一条已记录的响应为例进行了详细计算。解释了区域引用如何支持现有评分，以及在模型能力提升时如何解读性能表现。对七张生成的图像与其参考样本进行了对照分析，并收集了各类别的图集。记录了本次修订中存在的各种成果及其无法确定的内容。描述了人工评估的范围以及对定性示例的解读方法。

paragraphs.en: All 432 prompts were drafted with Claude Opus 4.6 and then reviewed by hand, entry by entry, over several rounds of revision. Construction proceeded in five stages.
paragraphs.zh: 所有 432 条提示词均使用 Claude Opus 4.6 起草，随后经过多轮修订，逐条进行人工审核。 构建工作分五个阶段进行。

paragraphs.en: First, we studied 160 seed prompts from X-Omni LongText-Bench to guide scene descriptions, target-string presentation, and region annotation. Three lessons carried into our own design: how a scene description should be organized, how a target string can be placed inside that description without announcing itself as a target, and how finely a scene should be divided into annotated regions. We settled on embedding each string where it naturally belongs, inside quotation marks, a code fence, or an explicit structural block as the scene requires, on describing every string together with the surface it is written on, and on varying the scene context from one prompt to the next.
paragraphs.zh: 首先，我们研究了来自 X-Omni LongText-Bench 的 160 个初始提示词，以指导场景描述、目标字符串的呈现以及区域的标注。 我们的设计借鉴了三个经验：场景描述应如何组织，如何将目标字符串嵌入描述中而不显明其目标身份，以及场景应如何精细地划分为多个标注区域。 我们最终决定根据场景需求，将每个字符串自然地嵌入引号、代码围栏或明确的结构块中；同时描述每个字符串及其所在的表面，并在不同提示词之间变化场景上下文。

paragraphs.en: Second, we wrote 9 prompts for each of the 24 categories in each language, 3 at every difficulty level, which yields the full 24 × 3 × 3 × 2 = 432 24\times 3\times 3\times 2=432 design. We generated one category at a time so that prompts within a category would not echo each other: no two share a business name, a location, or a content theme. The English and Chinese sets were written independently and adapted to their own cultural setting rather than translated from one another.
paragraphs.zh: 其次，我们为每种语言的 24 个类别分别编写了 9 条提示，每个难度级别包含 3 条，由此形成了完整的 24 × 3 × 3 × 2 = 432 的设计方案。 我们一次生成一个类别，以确保同一类别内的提示不会相互重复：没有任何两条提示共享相同的商业名称、地点或内容主题。 英语和中文的提示集是独立编写的，并根据各自的文化背景进行了调整，而非相互翻译而来。

paragraphs.en: Third, automated scripts checked every record against the specification. Each prompt’s GT-character load was recomputed as ∑ r | gt_regions [ r ] . text | \sum_{r}|\texttt{gt\_regions}[r].\texttt{text}| and compared against the design band for its language and level; plots those bands against the realized distributions. All 432 released records fall inside their own band under this definition. reports the resulting ranges. The scripts further verified that every region carries an identifier and all six annotated fields, and that every GT string appears verbatim somewhere in its own prompt. Most strings are set off by quotation marks, but code and other structured content may instead sit in a fenced or explicitly labeled block, so the check does not insist on a single quoting convention.

paragraphs.en: A generator receives the natural-language prompt and nothing else. The gt_regions array travels with the record as evaluation metadata and is never handed to the model as an additional layout input. Every region carries an id together with six attributes: its exact text , a position , a size , a type , a carrier , and an importance . Three of these draw on closed vocabularies: position names one of nine grid cells, size is large, medium, small, or tiny, and importance is high, medium, or low. Type and carrier are descriptive labels for the role the text plays and the surface it is written on. Carriers include digital interface elements as well as physical surfaces. Size labels describe qualitative text scale without pixel or font-size thresholds. Importance enters no scoring formula, and the rubric prohibits ignoring regions because they have lower importance. The 2,926 released regions contain 36 distinct type labels.
paragraphs.zh: 生成器仅接收自然语言提示，除此之外不再接收任何其他内容。 gt_regions 数组作为评估元数据随记录一同传递，绝不会作为额外的布局输入交给模型。 每个区域都携带一个 ID 以及六个属性：其精确文本、位置、大小、类型、载体和重要性。 其中三个属性使用封闭词汇表：位置名称为九个网格单元之一，大小为“大”“中”“小”或“极小”，重要性为“高”“中”或“低”。 类型和载体是对文本所扮演角色及其书写表面的描述性标签。 载体既包括数字界面元素，也包括物理表面。 大小标签描述了文本的定性规模，不涉及像素或字体大小的阈值。 重要性不会进入任何评分公式，且评分标准禁止因区域的重要性较低而忽略它们。 已发布的 2,926 个区域包含 36 个不同的类型标签。

paragraphs.en: The grid records a coarse location and nothing more: it carries no bounding box, no extent, and no ordering of regions within a cell. Region counts follow the supplied annotation entries, not OCR detections or line breaks: one region may contain a multi-line passage, and several regions may share a cell. Character load is the sum of the lengths of all region strings, spaces and punctuation included, which is neither a word count nor the length of the generation prompt. shows both conventions on a complete record.

paragraphs.en: The six domains below expand the 24 categories of . Each describes a family of scenes rather than a fixed template, and in all of them the text is supplied for reproduction: prices, totals, and other figures are given in the prompt and never have to be inferred or calculated.

paragraphs.en: A1 Sign puts text on physical signage seen at an angle, in outdoor light and on weathered material.
paragraphs.zh: A1 Sign 可在户外光线条件下、在倾斜角度以及老旧材料上呈现文本。

paragraphs.en: A2 Label asks for small type on compact or curved surfaces such as product bottles and price tags.
paragraphs.zh: A2 标签要求在小巧或弯曲的表面（如产品瓶和价格标签）上使用小型字体。

paragraphs.en: A3 Poster needs several levels of typographic hierarchy to hold up against a busy visual background.
paragraphs.zh: A3 海报需要多个层级的排版层次，才能在复杂的视觉背景中脱颖而出。

paragraphs.en: A4 Billboard renders large-format text at a viewing angle and under environmental effects.
paragraphs.zh: A4 广告牌以特定视角和环境效果渲染大尺寸文本。

paragraphs.en: B1 Article runs extended prose across paragraph breaks and line wraps, justified or left-aligned.
paragraphs.zh: B1 文章以扩展的散文形式呈现，段落之间和换行处均有内容，文本可两端对齐或左对齐。

paragraphs.en: B2 Newspaper fits several articles onto one page in multiple columns under a headline hierarchy.
paragraphs.zh: B2 报纸将多篇文章以多栏形式排布在单页上，并遵循标题层级结构。

paragraphs.en: B3 Letter follows the conventional form of a formal letter: salutation, body paragraphs, and closing.
paragraphs.zh: B3 信件遵循正式信件的常规格式：问候语、正文段落和结束语。

paragraphs.en: B4 Resume arranges sections, bullet points, and aligned dates, often across two columns.
paragraphs.zh: B4 简历会安排各个部分、项目符号和对齐的日期，通常分布在两列中。

paragraphs.en: C1 Menu aligns items with their prices across several sections, each carrying its own descriptions.
paragraphs.zh: C1 菜单将各个部分中的商品与其价格对齐，每个部分都包含各自的描述。

paragraphs.en: C2 Receipt places purchase details, subtotals, and totals on narrow thermal-print lines.
paragraphs.zh: C2 收据将购买详情、小计和总计信息排列在狭窄的热敏打印行上。

paragraphs.en: C3 Invoice arranges quantities, unit prices, and totals in a table beside issuer and recipient details.
paragraphs.zh: C3 发票将数量、单价和总计以表格形式排列在发行方和接收方信息的旁边。

paragraphs.en: C4 Product Packaging wraps ingredient lists and nutrition tables around a surface seen in perspective.
paragraphs.zh: C4 产品包装将成分表和营养信息环绕在一个透视视角下的表面上。

paragraphs.en: D1 Webpage combines navigation, content panels, sidebars, and footers at different type sizes.
paragraphs.zh: D1 网页将导航栏、内容面板、侧边栏和页脚以不同的字号组合在一起。

paragraphs.en: D2 Slide keeps a clean title-and-bullet structure with consistent indentation and a footer.
paragraphs.zh: D2 幻灯片采用简洁的标题与项目符号结构，缩进一致，并带有页脚。

paragraphs.en: D3 Social Media surrounds a post or feed with interface chrome, hashtags, timestamps, and engagement counts; conversational turn-taking belongs to Dialogue instead.
paragraphs.zh: D3 社交媒体会用界面元素、话题标签、时间戳和互动计数来包围帖子或信息流；而对话中的轮流发言则属于对话范畴。

paragraphs.en: D4 Dashboard packs KPI cards, chart labels, and table grids densely into a monitoring interface; Infographic, by contrast, organizes an explanatory narrative.
paragraphs.zh: D4 仪表板将关键绩效指标卡片、图表标签和表格网格密集地整合到监控界面中；而信息图则组织呈现一种解释性叙述。

paragraphs.en: E1 Schedule holds a time column in alignment and keeps formatting consistent from row to row.
paragraphs.zh: E1 时间表将时间列对齐，并确保各行格式保持一致。

paragraphs.en: E2 Form pairs labels with fields and adds checkboxes, section dividers, and instruction text.
paragraphs.zh: E2 将标签与字段配对，并添加复选框、部分分隔符和说明文本。

paragraphs.en: E3 Certificate centers formal typography at several sizes and depends on symmetry.
paragraphs.zh: E3 证书将正式排版集中在多种尺寸上，并依赖于对称性。

paragraphs.en: E4 Code requires a consistent monospace face, exact indentation, and recognizable syntax elements.
paragraphs.zh: E4 代码需要一致的等宽字体、精确的缩进以及可识别的语法元素。

paragraphs.en: F1 Caption requires readable text over a photographic or illustrated background.
paragraphs.zh: F1 图注需要在照片或插图背景上显示可读性文本。

paragraphs.en: F2 Dialogue alternates chat bubbles from one side to the other with speaker labels attached.
paragraphs.zh: F2 对话在聊天气泡之间交替切换，每侧都附有说话者标签。

paragraphs.en: F3 Comic Panel mixes speech bubbles, sound-effect words, and narrative caption boxes.
paragraphs.zh: F3 漫画格融合了对话气泡、拟声词和叙述性说明框。

paragraphs.en: F4 Infographic scatters data annotations, axis labels, and legends across a freeform layout.
paragraphs.zh: F4 信息图将数据标注、坐标轴标签和图例分散在自由形式的布局中。

paragraphs.en: A response counts as successful only if it is a single JSON object with exactly the six keys, each holding an integer between 0 and 100 inclusive. This status establishes response validity, not image quality or agreement with human judgments. Duplicate keys, extra keys, missing keys, booleans, strings, non-finite values, and values outside the range are all failures. API errors, safety refusals, empty responses, parser failures, and reference context overflow are likewise recorded with an explicit status and failure type, and every score field is set to null . Our implementation runs at temperature 0.0 with thinking disabled and a configurable response cap of 512 tokens by default, and it retains the raw response, the attempts, and the error details for every row.

paragraphs.en: Failure handling. The evaluator never turns a failed request or a malformed response into a score. Every planned prompt and sample row is kept, carrying a status such as missing , invalid_artifact , or judge_failed , and a failed row has null score fields and a typed reason for the failure. The raw response and the attempt errors are preserved with it. A safety refusal is treated as a non-blocking observation about the dataset and is counted as a failure state rather than converted into a quality score.
paragraphs.zh: 失败处理。 评估器绝不会将失败请求或格式错误的响应转化为分数。 每个计划好的提示词和样本行都会被保留，并带有缺失、无效工件或判断失败等状态；失败行的分数字段为 null，且会记录具体的失败原因。 原始响应和尝试过程中的错误也会一并保留。 安全拒绝会被视为对数据集的非阻断性观察，计为失败状态，而非转化为质量分数。

paragraphs.en: The rubric asks TA to assess character and word correctness and TC to assess the presence of every region with its entire required content. It does not specify an edit-distance calculation, a region-matching procedure, or how incorrect but present text contributes to TC. These remain judgments of the VLM, so a high TC score alone does not establish correct reproduction. For example, records TA=10 and TC=100, which become Fidelity=55. Keeping both raw scores makes that difference visible. The composite supplies no pass threshold: even a hypothetical TA=0 with all five other scores at 100 would produce a Composite of 70.
paragraphs.zh: 评分标准要求智能体评估字符和单词的正确性，并要求 TC 评估每个区域是否完整包含其所需的全部内容。 该标准并未明确说明编辑距离的计算方法、区域匹配的流程，或错误但存在的文本如何影响 TC 的评分。 这些判断仍由 VLM 完成，因此仅凭较高的 TC 分数并不能证明内容已被正确还原。 例如，记录显示 TA=10 和 TC=100，由此计算出的保真度为 55。 保留这两个原始分数可以清楚地显示出这种差异。 该综合评分并未设定任何及格阈值：即使假设 TA=0，而其他五个分数均为 100，综合评分仍会达到 70。

paragraphs.en: The two means differ because prompt-macro aggregation gives each represented prompt equal weight, whereas the image mean lets A count for twice as much as B. A prompt with no successful image contributes to the coverage denominator but has no quality mean to contribute at all. paragraphs.en: The structured reference connects each requested string to its intended role in the image. A list of words can establish which content should appear, while the region description also specifies where that content belongs and what should carry it. These requirements matter when a correct title appears above an incomplete menu, when a price is detached from its item, or when readable opening hours appear on the wrong side of a storefront. The reference makes such distinctions available to the evaluator across the benchmark’s scene categories.
paragraphs.zh: 结构化引用将每个请求的字符串与其在图像中的预期角色关联起来。 词语列表可以确定哪些内容应被呈现，而区域描述则同时指定了这些内容应放置的位置以及承载它们的元素。 当正确的标题出现在不完整的菜单上方、价格与对应商品分离，或可读的营业时间出现在店铺门面的错误一侧时，这些要求就显得尤为重要。 该引用使评估者能够在基准测试的各个场景类别中识别出此类区别。

paragraphs.en: The target string defines the content against which TA and TC are judged. A region may contain a single heading or a multi-line passage, so its presence does not establish that its entire content was reproduced. In the bakery record, the shop name, tagline, menu, and hours plate are four separate requirements. Correctly rendering the shop name leaves the other three to be checked. The packaging example in makes the same point from the opposite direction: detailed ingredient text does not replace the missing product title.

paragraphs.en: TR concerns whether the rendered characters are visually legible. SI concerns their relation to the carrier, including perspective, lighting, and material. A sharply drawn word can be misspelled, and correctly transcribed text can still look detached from its surface. The wooden sign in illustrates lettering that follows its carrier’s plane and texture. A crop exposes local character shapes, while the whole image shows their integration with the scene.
paragraphs.zh: TR 关注的是渲染出的字符在视觉上是否清晰可辨。 SI 关注的是字符与载体之间的关系，包括透视、光照和材质。 一个绘制得十分清晰的词也可能拼写错误，而正确转录的文本看起来仍可能与载体表面脱节。 示例中的木制标牌展示了遵循其载体平面和纹理的字体设计。 局部裁剪能展现字符的形态细节，而整幅图像则显示了这些字符与场景的整体融合。

paragraphs.en: The six reference attributes describe the target scene, while the six raw scores describe the generated image. Their roles differ: importance , for example, is metadata and supplies no numerical weight. The rubric instructs the judge to assess lower-importance regions as well. Reference attributes guide the image-level judgments without defining a separate score for every attribute or region. The four reporting dimensions and Composite remain the mappings in ; the protocol introduces no additional region-level metric.
paragraphs.zh: 六个参考属性描述目标场景，而六个原始分数则描述生成的图像。 它们的作用不同：例如，“重要性”是元数据，不提供任何数值权重。 评分标准要求评估者对重要性较低的区域也进行评估。 参考属性指导图像层面的判断，但并未为每个属性或区域定义独立的分数。 四个报告维度与“综合得分”在中的映射关系保持不变；该协议未引入任何额外的区域层面指标。

paragraphs.en: Improved rendering of short strings shifts attention toward whether models can preserve text across longer passages, multiple regions, and varied carriers. A receipt must retain its item-price associations, a form must preserve its fields, and a storefront must render both its prominent name and its smaller supporting text. UltraText Bench evaluates these demands with one rubric.
paragraphs.zh: 对短字符串的改进渲染将注意力转向模型是否能在更长的段落、多个区域和不同载体中保留文本。 收据必须保留其商品与价格之间的关联，表格必须保持其字段，而商店门面则必须同时呈现醒目的名称和较小的辅助文本。 UltraText Bench 使用单一评估标准来检验这些需求。

paragraphs.en: The comparisons in reveal substantial variation within this setting. Qwen-Image-2512 receives an EN Composite of 86.50 at L1 and 42.86 at L3; Z-Image-Base receives 82.92 and 26.34, respectively. GPT Image 2 [Low] remains near the top of the scale in both languages at every level. These outcomes distinguish configurations that sustain high rated quality across workloads from those with large performance differences between the groups. Each group contains different prompts with varying text loads and numbers of regions.
paragraphs.zh: 这些比较揭示了该设置内部存在显著差异。 Qwen-Image-2512 在 L1 上的 EN 综合得分为 86.50，在 L3 上为 42.86；Z-Image-Base 的得分分别为 82.92 和 26.34。 GPT Image 2 [Low] 在所有层级、两种语言中均保持在评分量表接近顶端的位置。 这些结果区分了那些在不同工作负载下都能维持高质量配置与那些组间性能差异较大的配置。 每个组都包含不同的提示，其文本负载和区域数量也各不相同。

paragraphs.en: The dimensions also distinguish configurations with similar overall scores. Qwen-Image-2512 and Boogu-Image-0.1-Turbo receive Composites of 67.96 and 67.79. Qwen-Image-2512 has higher Clarity, 79.89 versus 64.86, while Boogu-Image-0.1-Turbo has higher Fidelity, 66.27 versus 59.30. Their close overall scores thus summarize different balances between legibility and content reproduction. Alongside the workload breakdowns, these measurements help identify the capabilities a model retains and the aspects of dense text generation that remain difficult.
paragraphs.zh: 这些维度还能区分出整体得分相近的不同配置。 Qwen-Image-2512 和 Boogu-Image-0.1-Turbo 的复合得分为 67.96 和 67.79。 Qwen-Image-2512 的清晰度更高，为 79.89（对比 64.86），而 Boogu-Image-0.1-Turbo 的保真度更高，为 66.27（对比 59.30）。 因此，它们相近的整体得分反映了在可读性与内容还原之间不同的平衡取舍。 除了工作负载的细分分析，这些测量结果还有助于识别模型保留的能力，以及密集文本生成中仍具挑战性的方面。

paragraphs.en: Each of the seven cases below pairs a whole image with a crop at native resolution, quotes the part of the reference that matters, and states what can be seen. All seven come from GPT Image 2 [Low], and every figure places the whole image at left and the outlined crop at right. An outline marks where a crop was taken and is an editorial annotation, not a GT box. Each score line reproduces the judge’s whole-image response in the order TA, TC, TR, PC, LQ, SI, followed by the composite; these describe the whole image rather than the crop, and none is a human rating assigned here. The cases were chosen to show how the dimensions overlap in practice, and they include a positive integration example and disagreements at low and maximum scores. These selected cases do not estimate how often each failure occurs.

paragraphs.en: The complete EN and ZH prompt records, together with the released evaluator, support the dataset counts, the region inventories, the six raw metrics, strict response validation, typed failure states, and the four-dimension composite. The GPT Image 2 [Low] release adds images and per-image judge rows: 859/864 successful EN images over 215/216 prompts, and 864/864 successful ZH images over 216/216 prompts. Four missing EN images belong to F3_L1_EN_003 and one to A4_L2_EN_003 . The recorded scores reproduce the bilingual prompt-macro Composite of 99.35. All six raw dimensions equal 100 for 732/859 valid EN images and 708/864 valid ZH images, or 1,440/1,723 (83.6%) together. These counts describe automatic ratings, without assigning correctness labels to the images. The cases shown in are drawn from these records.

paragraphs.en: The GPT Image 2 cases selected here are qualitative examples rather than a representative sample of error rates. The released judge summaries identify Qwen-Image-Bench , but their model_revision and model_artifact_sha256 fields are null. The recorded identity hash does not fix the checkpoint weights. These records therefore support checking score aggregation and image bindings, with incomplete checkpoint provenance. The GPT Image 2 records do not establish the coverage or score distribution of the other model configurations in the leaderboard.
paragraphs.zh: 此处选中的 GPT Image 2 案例属于定性示例，而非错误率的代表性样本。 已发布的裁判摘要中识别到了 Qwen-Image-Bench，但其 model_revision 和 model_artifact_sha256 字段为 null。 记录的身份哈希无法确定检查点的权重。 因此，这些记录可用于验证分数聚合与图像绑定，但检查点的来源信息并不完整。 GPT Image 2 的记录无法说明排行榜中其他模型配置所覆盖的范围或分数分布情况。

paragraphs.en: Reproduction across all configurations requires their model revisions, resolutions, sampling settings, API quality settings and evaluation dates, together with images, raw judge responses, and the status of every planned row. Image and prompt coverage should accompany each quality mean. Comparing only shared prompts can assess how differences in coverage affect a pair of models; uncertainty estimates should account for images sharing a prompt. These further comparisons are not reported here.
paragraphs.zh: 在所有配置中进行复现需要其模型修订版本、分辨率、采样设置、API 质量设置和评估日期，以及图像、原始裁判响应和每个计划行的状态。 每张图像和提示词都应伴随相应的质量均值。 仅比较共享的提示词可以评估覆盖范围差异如何影响一对模型；不确定性估计应考虑到共享同一提示词的图像。 这些进一步的比较在此未予报告。

paragraphs.en: The selected cases in pair whole images with native-resolution crops and the relevant target text. These views support different checks: the crop exposes character shapes, while the whole image shows placement and carrier fit. The hours plate in appears at bottom-left rather than the requested bottom-right; the lettering in follows the wooden sign’s plane, lighting, and texture. The cases also retain disagreements with the automatic scores. Target-related chat text is visible in despite zero accuracy and completeness ratings, while the code image in contains degraded small characters despite maximum ratings. These selected observations do not estimate the frequency of scoring errors or establish the reliability of close leaderboard rankings.
paragraphs.zh: 所选案例将整张图片与原始分辨率的裁剪图以及相关的目标文本结合展示。 这些视图支持不同的检查：裁剪图能展现字符形状，而整张图片则显示其位置与载体的适配性。 小时盘出现在左下角，而非要求的右下角；其中的文字则遵循木质标志的面板、光照和纹理。 这些案例也保留了与自动评分结果存在分歧的情况。 尽管准确率和完整性评分均为零，但与目标相关的聊天文本仍然可见；而代码图片中则包含质量下降的小字符，尽管其评分为最高。 这些选定的观察结果既无法评估评分错误的频率，也无法确定接近的排行榜排名是否可靠。

paragraphs.en: A score of 100 is the upper end of the judge’s rubric, not a measured percentage of correct characters. Within a subset whose automatic scores are all 100, Pearson and Spearman correlations with those scores are undefined. Assessing such a subset requires examining the human ratings and the rendered text directly. A high human quality rating does not establish exact character reproduction, which requires transcription checks.
paragraphs.zh: 100分是评分标准中的最高分值，而非正确字符所占的精确百分比。 在自动评分均为100分的子集中，与这些分数相关的皮尔逊和斯皮尔曼相关系数是无定义的。 要评估这样的子集，必须直接考察人类评分和生成的文本。 高的人类质量评分并不能证明字符被完全准确地还原，这还需要通过转录检查来确认。
